name: renewal-world-monsters
author: BlaXun
description: The ordinary monsters of renewal's new lands, for pre-renewal with levels up to 175. Every monster keeps its renewal level: Malaya, Rockridge and Izlude's fifth floor from 100, Bifrost and El Dicastes up to 145, Eclage, Rockridge's mine and Verus up to 171, the quest areas up to 175; Dewata and Malangdo sit at 70 to 99. Their strength is set by fights on a test server, one level step at a time, against parties of third classes of that level: a region is party content, a step harder than the one below, and never unfair. They drop renewal's loot; its equipment and cards come with renewal-world-gear and renewal-world-cards, its bosses with renewal-world-mvps. Needs renewal-world for the maps, and a mod that takes characters past level 99 to meet the monsters at their level.
